claim_text: The September 17, 2025 indictment in United States v. Aden et al., No. 0:25-cr-00349 (ECF 1), alleges that between approximately September 2022 and April 2025 Brilliant Minds Services LLC submitted reimbursement claims totaling about $2.3 million, and that the defendants claimed to be entitled to nearly $2.3 million for purported services to nearly 350 beneficiaries. That is an amount_billed / amount_claimed charging allegation, not amount_paid and not proven_loss. Paragraph 14 and paragraph 21 describe the same Brilliant Minds figure and must not be summed.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, between approximately September 2022 and April 2025, Brilliant Minds submitted reimbursement claims totaling about $2.3 million.
Ultimately, the defendants claimed to service nearly 350 different beneficiaries through Brilliant Minds and for such services claimed to be entitled to nearly $2.3 million.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 14: submitted reimbursement claims totaling about $2.3 million. Face of charging document; not amount_paid.

qualifiers: do not add to Falade billed dollars or FOF $250M
do not sum with para 21 claimed-entitlement restatement
editorial_notes: Do not add Aden personal-pocketing $300k–$400k or Amex charges to this billed figure.
